items.title: Show HN: Hosted JayBase – An append-only data store for safe AI agent writes
items.contentSnippet:
Just launched the hosted version of my JayBase project, which I shared with you guys a few months ago. (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48999936) I'm really trying to design it from the ground up to be the way that agents can interact with business data, in the same way they can interact with code (by having a built-in history and built-in auditability, in the same way that coding agents do with Git). I'd love to get your feedback.
